tailoring.headline: Senior E-Commerce Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud, Java & Spring | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Works in a techno-functional role between business and IT.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Product Owner:in E-Commerce (all genders)
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce engineering and techno-functional delivery experience across SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for the Senior Product Owner:in E-Commerce role at tink. My background bridges technical architecture and business requirements, ensuring seamless feature delivery and robust platform scalability.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Analysed business requirements with stakeholders, authored user stories and functional specifications, and translated complex demands into SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation.

bullets.label: API & Integration Delivery
bullets.text: Designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and built PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders, and DataHub to synchronize global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes, and supported user acceptance testing (UAT) at Shell.

bullets.label: Platform Optimization & Quality
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency, managed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, and maintained high code quality with automated unit testing.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving my notice period with a last working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start on 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can benefit tink.

tailoring.why_company: tink is a leading European platform for connected home and smart technologies, offering an innovative environment where high-performing e-commerce systems directly impact customer experience. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce experience, techno-functional background, and stakeholder management skills to help scale tink's digital platforms and drive impactful product features.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years building large enterprise e-commerce platforms and bridging business with IT, I am excited to contribute my techno-functional expertise to tink.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience across SAP Commerce platforms, I have applied for the Senior Product Owner:in E-Commerce role at tink. My background in requirements analysis, API integrations, and agile delivery aligns well with your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Product Owner:in E-Commerce - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Product Owner:in E-Commerce position at tink. With over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce experience building and managing SAP Commerce platforms, working closely with business stakeholders, and driving technical integrations, I am confident in my ability to add value to your team. I hold a valid work permit and can start on 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
